name: Malaria control data systems
summary: A large, geographically concentrated, preventable disease burden with plausible software leverage in surveillance, reporting, logistics, case management, and decision-support systems used by public-health programs.

metrics.claim: WHO reported an estimated 282 million malaria cases and 610,000 malaria deaths globally in 2024.
WHO reported that the African Region accounted for about 95% of malaria deaths in 2024, with young children carrying much of the burden.

software_pathways.claim: Likely OSS pathways include DHIS2/CHT-like surveillance and case-management workflows, supply-chain tooling, test-result data quality, offline sync, and reporting exports; candidate projects need maintainer and deployment evidence.
